summary: Keep existing persisted message rows mounted during history prepends.

components.disposition: Persisted rows use session identity, source ordinal and weakly held raw-message object identity instead of relative list index. Prepending earlier history preserves existing DOM and local UI state; a replacement snapshot (including retraction) or session switch remounts rather than retaining stale local state. Live row keys retain relative-index behavior. Use Set for produced path deduplication. No change to storage, history content, Run, or authority.
evidence: 68 WebUI test files / 674 tests PASS, TypeScript and diff checks PASS.

DOM regression test prepends 50 older messages to 500 existing persisted rows and asserts all 500 node identities preserved; separate test verifies replacement/retraction and session switch remount; existing scroll anchor, duplicate click and failure tests retained.
components.verification_level: Local DOM/unit regression; real desktop/mobile browser timing and virtualization still pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Veto if rows are lost, stale retracted content or edit state survives replacement, session identity crosses views, or scrolling regresses. This is stable reconciliation, not full list virtualization or a measured click latency improvement.
components.rollback_route: Revert UI-only change; canonical history and execution unaffected.
